description: Digital rank data from Similarweb - a domain's global, country and industry rank, an app's store rank, the top-ranked sites, the category tree, and the account's capabilities and remaining data credits.

api.description: Read the countries, stores, modes and devices the app rank operation accepts, which is the only way to know a valid mode

fields.type: { countries: string[], stores: { store: string, mode: string, device: string }[] }

api.description: Read an app's store rank day by day for one country and chart, from the App Store or Google Play

fields.description: Google for Android, Apple for iOS.
The store id, such as com.whatsapp or 310633997.
A two-letter ISO code, or world.
An app category, or all. Sent as all when omitted.
The chart to read, such as free, paid, topselling_free or topgrossing. apps.describe lists every accepted value per store. Sent as topselling_free when omitted, which both stores accept.
androidphone, iphone or ipad. Sent as the store's phone (androidphone or iphone) when omitted.
Days back from today. Sent as 90 when omitted.

fields.type: { request?: Record<string, any> | null, status?: string | null, last_updated?: string | null }

fields.description: One entry per day, oldest first.

api.description: Read what the subscription entitles this account to, keyed by capability name

fields.description: What the account is entitled to, keyed by capability name. The keys depend on the subscription.

api.description: Read the website category tree, with each child mapping to the Parent~Child slug the rank routes accept

fields.description: Top-level category to its children, each child mapping to the Parent~Child slug. A top level with no children is an empty object.

api.description: Read the data credit allowance and how many this user has left; costs no credits

fields.description: Credits allocated to this user for the period.
Credits this user has left.
allowance minus user_remaining, when both are present.

api.description: Read a domain's rank within one country month by month, for a country code the subscription includes

fields.description: The domain without 'www.' or brackets, lower case, such as cnn.com. A path or capital letters make Similarweb answer 401.
The first month. Omit both dates for the last 28 days.
The last month.
True for the main domain only, false to include subdomains. Defaults to false.
A two-letter ISO country code. Which countries are available depends on the subscription; capabilities.get lists them. Worldwide is not supported here; use websites.globalRank.

fields.type: { request?: Record<string, any> | null, status?: string | null, last_updated?: string | null }

fields.description: One entry per month, oldest first.

api.description: Read a domain's global rank month by month, based on estimated unique visitors and page views across desktop and mobile

fields.description: The domain without 'www.' or brackets, lower case, such as cnn.com. A path or capital letters make Similarweb answer 401.
The first month. Omit both dates for the last 28 days.
The last month.
True for the main domain only, false to include subdomains. Defaults to false.

fields.type: { request?: Record<string, any> | null, status?: string | null, last_updated?: string | null }

fields.description: The industry path, such as E-commerce_and_Shopping/Marketplace.
The rank within that industry, worldwide.

api.description: Read the highest-ranked domains worldwide across desktop and mobile, up to 5000 of them

fields.description: How many sites to return, up to 5000. Defaults to 10.
